name: slurpyb-agent-skills
description: A curated collection of AI agent plugins and skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: simple-english
plugins.description: An agent skill that forces LLMs to write docs in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Shape Claude Code output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number steps, suppress tangents, restate state, make wins visible.

plugins.name: design-eng-skills
plugins.description: State machine design, changeset writing, engineering writing, and component API design skills.

plugins.name: sbx-agent
plugins.description: Docker Sandboxes (sbx) expertise: run and operate sandboxes, author kits and template images, wire MCP servers through the gateway, govern a fleet, and work out why a sandbox cannot reach, build, or keep something.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Shared agent defaults for every project: conventions, tools, and always-on behavior.

plugins.name: astro-agent
plugins.description: Astro expertise for coding agents: current docs via MCP, project conventions, and a specialist subagent for .astro sites, Content Collections, islands, adapters, Starlight, actions, and i18n.

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Autonomous research loop: infer artifact, evaluator, and bounds from a goal, then iterate sequential rounds and escalate to a GAN tournament on plateau.

plugins.name: capture
plugins.description: Brain-dump organizer: unstructured thoughts into projects, tasks, connections, and offers, with zero information loss.

plugins.name: code-context
plugins.description: Retrieve code context via DeepWiki, Context7, Exa, git clone, or web search+fetch.

plugins.name: plugin-optimizer
plugins.description: Validate and optimize a Claude Code plugin against official best practices and file patterns.

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Code simplification agent and skills that improve quality while preserving behavior.

plugins.name: storm
plugins.description: Wikipedia-style long-form articles via multi-perspective research and retrieval. Claude-native port of Stanford STORM.

plugins.name: shopify-plugin
plugins.description: Search Shopify docs, generate and validate GraphQL, Liquid, and UI extension code.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering — grilling, spec/ticket flows, TDD, code review, domain modelling and more. Plug-and-play, not vibe coding.

plugins.name: davidondrej-skills
plugins.description: David Ondrej's agent skills: orchestration loops, skill authoring, web research, structured thinking, and ops setup.

plugins.name: fuse-prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Expert Prompt Engineer with Context Engineering, Meta-Prompting, Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot, Agent Design, 50+ Template Library, and A/B Testing
